description:
A lightweight 26-inch electric mountain bike designed for daily commuting, trail riding, and efficient outdoor exploration.

1500W Peak Motor offers reliable support for hills, commutes, and recreational rides.

48V 10Ah Battery delivers up to 35 miles of max riding range.

26" x 2.0" Tires provide efficient rolling performance for pavement and light trails.

Front Suspension Fork helps absorb bumps and improve control.

Precision Disc Brakes provide dependable stopping power.

7-Speed Transmission makes it easier to adapt to different terrain.

IPX6 Water Resistance supports use in changing outdoor conditions.

49.6 lbs Lightweight Build makes the bike easier to handle than heavier fat tire models.

350 lbs Max Payload supports a wide range of riders.

The F26 26-Inch Electric Mountain Bike is built for riders who want a practical, efficient, and affordable electric bike for commuting, fitness, and outdoor exploration. With a 1500W peak motor, 48V 10Ah battery, and up to 35 miles of max range, the F26 delivers dependable electric assistance for everyday rides.
Its 26" x 2.0" tires offer efficient rolling performance, while the front suspension fork helps smooth out bumps on city streets, bike paths, and light trails. The precision disc brakes provide confident stopping power, and the 7-speed transmission allows flexible riding across different road conditions.
At only 49.6 lbs, the F26 is lighter and easier to maneuver compared with many high-power fat tire eBikes, making it a strong choice for riders who want an electric mountain bike that balances value, range, and usability.
